items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: I remember Eddie Henderson called me when Head Hunters were getting ready to play, and he wanted me to play the bass.

ctx.x: Very interesting David, thank you. Last question, I looked at your calendar on line and you seem to have frequent gigs, working a lot. Do you ever have days where you wish you weren’t working and what do you do to sort of get up for that gig? Or maybe it’s just —

I’ve never had that problem. I always look forward to playing. Yeah. I have a family to support. So I had the four kids, my wife and the four kids, and she wasn’t working. I was making — I’m telling you man making a living working as a jazz musician is like walking on water. And I was able to do it because of my faith in the Lord. I was able to do it but it’s like walking on water. I always enjoyed playing so much I never had that feeling of it being a burden on a particular day to have to go play. So it’s…

Well you remind me here at Hamilton College the motto of the college is “know thyself” and it sounds like you do. Well I want to thank you for your time today, this has really been a joy to learn what’s going on. I won’t call it a music machine but up here.
